title: Supabase dashboard showcase
description: A two-tone title (ink over grey), a row of rounded pill tabs where the active one gets an ink border, and a wide white browser window with three grey dots that runs off the section's bottom edge, holding a 16:9 screenshot or video slot. Clicking a tab swaps the media; hovering a tab greys its border.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tabs (hydrate visible); without it the first tab shows
the window is cropped by the section bottom (aspect ratio), so the media's lower part is hidden on purpose
